newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network margins under pressure.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp president and chief executive officer Thomas Hudson said it expects its net margins to remain under pressure through the first half of next year.

"Net margins will continue to be negatively affected by our investment spending until we gain additional sales momentum and our planned new products begin to penetrate the market in the first half of 1997," Hudson said in a statement.

But the executive noted, "We remain committed to our investment strategy of developing new product solutions and strengthening our infrastructure to meet the needs of our customers. I am very pleased that our core Channelink products are experiencing healthy volume growth."
Computer Network Technology develops and markets high-performance networking products.
